following the listening surveys conducted over the past few years which some of you took part in, the following key area will be discussed: 1. belonging. 2. c0-responsibilty ministry. 3. family. 4. formation and catechesis. 5. healing. 6. women and 7. youth. we keep the process in our prayers. vocations: please continue to pray for vocations by using the prayer especially for more priests for the kerry diocese. please pray also for priests who are sick at this moment. thank you. confirmation: this weekend we welcome our confirmation candidates as they begin their journey to confirmation. please remember them in your prayers; november envelopes: november envelopes and lists will be distrib uted to you homes in the next few weeks along with our programme for november. parish projects: (1) defibrillators: the ppc are pressing ahead to try to get defibrillato rs installed as soon as possi- ble and the training organised. (2) trees in the grounds of churchill church: the boundary trees in chur chill church grounds are being examined at the moment and will be cut as soon as possible. (3) carpet: the carpet for the sanctuary area of fenit church is pro mised to be fitted in the next few weeks as the company doing the work have been very busy of late. god bless, fr. francis. adoration of the most blessed sacrament tuesday in fenit church from 10.30am until 12 noon. rosary 9.45am. thursday in churchill church from 3.00pm until 7.15pm with benediction before even- ing mass. mass cards: mass bouquet cards, sympathy, get well and general mass bouquet cards signed by fr. francis are available in the gala shop, fenit and also from anne daughton, sacristan, churchill. used stamps in aid of the missions: can be given to anne daughton, sacristan. parish collection: 10th/11th october 2026: €1,355.70 (offertory & envelopes €755.70, priests income €620.00). sincere thanks for your support of the parish. mile buióchas. tom crowley memorial table quiz: takes place on thursday 5th november in the oyster tavern at 8.00pm. table of five - €50.00. lots of valuable rafòe prizes and entertainment. all wel- come to participate. all proceeds in aid of the kerry hospice foundation. donations also welcome and may be made online at

mission sunday: this sunday, 18th october, is mission sunday. a special mission collection will be taken up at all masses. your support is greatly appreciated. the irish cancer society is seeking volunteer drivers to join our transport team. we are currently looking for drivers in kerry, particularly those who can drive to hospitals in lim- erick. as a volunteer driver, you will bring patients attend- ing chemotherapy appointments to hospital and safely home again. by giving your time, you can help make travel- ling for treatment a little easier for people affected by can-cer. if you can spare 2 days per month, have a valid driving licence, and a safe, reliable vehicle, you are the perfect candidate to make a difference. for more information on how to become a volunteer driver, please contact monica or emily at

diocesan prayer for vocations heavenly father, you call each of us by name and invite us to follow your son with generous hearts. pour out your holy spirit upon our diocese of kerry, that young people may encounter christ and have the courage to answer your call. raise up holy priests to proclaim your word, celebrate the eucharist with joy, and serve your people with humble love. strengthened those already called to be faithful witnesses to the gospel. through the prayers of mary, mother of the church, and st. brendan, our patron saint, bless our diocese with joyful and generous vocations to the priesthood, for the glory of your name and the life of the world. we ask this christ our lord. amen. hse: free hse information evening: learn about fair deal, enduring power of attorney, sage advocacy, age friendly homes and more information stands from 7.30pm, talks begin at 8pm thursday, 22 october: meadowlands hotel, oakpark, tralee, v92 dc83. spa
